verdict.rationale: Manufact provides git-based versioning (branch-linked deployments, deployment history with commit info, setting canonical production branch) and review mechanisms (publish checklist audits, cross-client testing) for MCP servers, but there's no explicit rollback feature documented — no 'revert to previous deployment' or rollback button described anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert capability, evidence of restoring a prior deployment version, independent confirmation of these workflows in practice.
